phase: Fiscal Primary Balance — Matched Quarterly Source Materialisation
purpose: Materialise Romania's quarterly general-government primary balance from definitionally matched Eurostat B9 and D41PAY observations before any fiscal-reaction estimation.

overall_balance.concept: Net lending (+) / net borrowing (-), percent of quarterly GDP
overall_balance.sign: positive = surplus/net lending; negative = deficit/net borrowing

interest_expenditure.concept: Interest expenditure/payable, percent of quarterly GDP

measurement_identity.interpretation: Because B9 already includes interest expenditure in total expenditure, adding positive D41PAY removes interest from the overall balance. Positive primary balance denotes primary surplus.

official_methodology_basis.note: Eurostat identifies B9 as net lending/net borrowing and D41PAY as interest expenditure in quarterly S13 non-financial accounts. The European Commission Debt Sustainability Monitor uses B9 and D41PAY from gov_10q_ggnfa on quarterly NSA/PC_GDP boundaries.

vintage_rules.reason: A primary-balance series must not mix B9 from a new provider vintage with D41PAY from an older retained vintage.

next_gate: After a retained matched primary-balance snapshot exists, separately preregister debt-gap, output-gap and dated fiscal-regime measurement before any reaction-function structural selection.
